recipes.name: Spring Fruit Trifle
ingredients_raw: 2 tablespoons orange-flavored liqueur or orange juice
3 cups seasonal fresh fruit, such as sliced peeled kiwi, blueberries and/or sliced strawberries
2 pkg. (4 serving size) JELL-O Vanilla Flavor Instant Pudding & Pie Filling
6 (1 ounce) squares BAKER'S Premium White Baking Chocolate, melted, cooled slightly
1 (8 ounce) tub COOL WHIP Whipped Topping, thawed, divided

steps.text: Break wafers coarsely into a 2 ½-quart clear glass serving bowl. Drizzle with liqueur; layer on fruit.
Pour cold milk into a medium bowl; add dry pudding mix. Whisk until well blended, about 2 minutes; refrigerate until pudding starts to thicken.
Add melted chocolate to thickened pudding; whisk until well blended. Gently stir in ½ whipped topping until incorporated; spoon over fruit. Top with remaining ½ whipped topping.
Refrigerate before serving, at least 30 minutes or up to 24 hours. Refrigerate any leftover trifle.

raw_recipe.headline: Spring Fruit Trifle
raw_recipe.description: This spring fruit trifle recipe features crushed Nilla wafers, kiwi, strawberries, and blueberries topped with whipped pudding and white chocolate.

review.reviewBody: I used 2 pkg 4-serving pudding. I mixed in 1/3 C milk and got a brick. I had to add about a cup of milk to get something even close to needing to "firm up" in the fridge. Other than that, this desert is amazing. DO OVER!!
Was wondering if anyone else had an issue with the melted white chocolate hardening when it was mixed into the pudding mixture?
I made this quick and easy recipe for my family and boyfriend and they absolutely loved it. The mixture of white chocolate and pudding was so Delish. I cannot wait to make it again.

Really nice summer recipe. Make sure to pick up the smaller size puddings - 4 serving size. I thought it was 4 ounces and could not find the right size. People ate it all up at the pool party and it looks pretty too. I used kiwi, blackberries and peaches.
AWESOME! A huge hit at at least 3 parties I have used this.
